text: A particle is projected from a point on horizontal ground. At the instant 2 s after projection, the
particle has travelled a horizontal distance of 30 m and is at its greatest height above the ground. Find
the initial speed and the angle of projection of the particle. [5]
A uniform solid hemisphere of weight 60 N and radius 0.8 m rests in limiting equilibrium with its
curved surface on a rough horizontal plane. The axis of symmetry of the hemisphere is inclined at an
angle of 1 to the horizontal, where cos 1 = 0.28. Equilibrium is maintained by a horizontal force of
magnitude P N applied to the lowest point of the circular rim of the hemisphere (see diagram).

parts.text:
